description: A 2x2 grid of small-multiple charts. Each panel contains vertically oriented, side-by-side bars that are stacked by color (all rectangles).

components.description: Template for a single repeated small-multiple panel of adjacent vertical bars with stacked segments; laid out in a 2D grid. The coordinate represents the outer boundary of all panel instances.

primary.explanation: Two columns along x: left and right halves.

secondary.explanation: Two rows along y: bottom and top halves.

primary.explanation: Approximate number of histogram bins per panel laid out side-by-side along x.

secondary.explanation: Three stacked categories/colors within each bar along y.
